title: Surface-free E003 deployment candidate and feature-family ablations
hypothesis: A test-deployable subset of E003 legal evidence can retain a material repeated-fold datum-plus-trend gain without the six training-only formation-surface columns, and can be packaged as a deterministic offline submission notebook.

design.baseline: E001 last-known TVT at pooled RMSE 15.9098528707
design.deployment_contract: Test horizontal files provide MD, X, Y, Z, GR, and TVT_input. The six formation-surface columns exist in train but are absent from test and are therefore forbidden from E004 inference.
legal_inputs: MD, X, Y, Z for the complete supplied well
whole-well row count, boundary, hidden length, and geometry
forbidden_inputs: ANCC, ASTNU, ASTNL, EGFDU, EGFDL, and BUDA at inference
Geology annotations absent from test typewells
ablations: geometry plus prefix plus GR core
design.model: fixed-alpha standardized multi-output ridge with training-fold-only correlation screening to 48 features
design.selection_rule: Among candidates passing all registered action, tail, and spatial gates, select lowest mean repeated-map RMSE; break exact ties by fewer families then candidate ID.
edge_cases: sample duplicate, missing, extra, visible-row, and order mismatches
same-well visible authoring examples must not be treated as generalization evidence
controls: visible-test feature drift audit labeled authoring-only
exact sample ID and row reconstruction
remote Kaggle MCP parity required for deployment-ready status
design.promotion: A surface-free candidate must improve at least 0.15 RMSE on at least four repeated maps, satisfy p90 and worst-5% tail limits, retain positive spatial-block gain, pass signed datum gates and all local deployment controls. Deployment-ready additionally requires remote Kaggle MCP notebook parity.
